jobs.prompt: Opus round-3 review of the orchestrator-mode guard found one HIGH and two small problems. Fix in tools/orchestrator-allow.mjs, tools/handbuild.mjs and tools/shell-writes.mjs and extend tests/orchestrator-allow.test.mjs (full-guard tests, hand-build guard on and off). (1) HIGH: the orchestrator may create files in its own folders (docs/plans/) with the Write or Edit tool, and a bare test run ('node --test', 'npx vitest run', 'npm test', 'pytest', 'npx vitest run plans') then finds and runs a test file it wrote there (confirmed live: a test file in the plans folder ran). Fix in the Write/Edit/NotebookEdit path of the guard (the function that decides which files the orchestrator session may write; see orchestratorModeProtectedWriteRel and the write decision in handbuild.mjs): deny creating or editing, inside the orchestrator-owned folders (the dot swarm folder and the docs plans folder and any other ORCHESTRATOR_OWN folder), a file whose name looks like a test or a test runner configuration: names with a dot test or dot spec part before the extension for js, mjs, cjs, ts, mts, cts, jsx and tsx files; python files whose name starts with the word test followed by an underscore or ends with an underscore followed by the word test; the python conftest file; and runner config files for vitest, playwright, jest, pytest (ini and cfg and toml variants), tox and mocha, plus a package manifest named package followed by dot json. Build these checks as regular expressions on the base name in code. Existing legitimate writes of plan and note files stay allowed. (2) MED pytestArgs: it accepts python -c ... -m pytest because it looks for -m pytest anywhere; require the form python or python3 [-I] -m pytest with nothing between the interpreter and -m except -I. (3) LOW budget: take the verb as the first non-flag word after budget or budgets and allow only show (and no verb); 'swarm budget --daily 1000 set' must be denied. Keep every attack form denied and every bug-report command allowed (swarm go --scope wave --max-jobs 2, swarm tickets T-0001 --retry-note x, swarm tickets --help, gh pr view 12, gh run view 5, grep -rn foo src, cat README.md, git status, git log --oneline -5, npx playwright test, npx vitest run, npm test with a package.json script, node --test, pytest, python3 -m pytest). Keep tests/orchestrator-mode*.test.mjs, tests/shell-writes*.test.mjs, tests/auto-approve.test.mjs and tests/handbuild*.test.mjs passing without editing their assertions. IMPORTANT: secret scanner: no credential-looking literals in tests.
